evidence.defect: SpccArmState.add_fetch appended the body to self.fetched; build rendered self.fetched into L3 for that turn only and cleared it, and the queued journal line carried only the question. A fixture delivery therefore appeared in exactly one prompt.
evidence.measured: rows-smoke-spcc-2026-11-10.jsonl: body 3000 delivered turn 1, expected_present=False at turn 3; body 3001 delivered turn 4, expected_present=False at turn 6; model emitted CALL get_doc(doc_id="doc-fact-01") at turns 4-5.
evidence.fix: arm_cd.py: new add_delivery(body) appends to self.fetched (L3 this turn) AND self.delivered; build() appends self.delivered to the journal-line content before format_journal_line, so deliveries persist in L2 until compaction. add_fetch unchanged: L3 only, cleared each turn, never L0/L1/L2. run_longrun.py spcc branch now calls add_delivery for _turn_tool_outputs bodies.
evidence.invariant: fetches never enter L0/L1/L2 is preserved and now proven by test_model_fetch_never_enters_l0_l1_l2, which asserts on the compiled prompt's own layer split (reconstructed byte-exact against the prompt string).
